Summarised translation of a communist handbill entitled
"Urgent Notice No.A.110", which was obtained by the
Municipal Police in Western Chapei on January 22, 1933.

Comrade Wong Bing (黄正) was arrested by the
Special Squad of the District Kuomintang in Tientsin on
December 14, 1932, and subsequently escorted to Nanking.
It has not been ascertained whether he is still alive.
He has been cruelly tortured at the hands of the
Kuomintang but showed his great sacrificing nature
by remaining loyal to the Proletarian classes. He is
a leader of the Chinese labour movement and member of
the Committee of the World Anti-Imperialist League.
The various branches of the Party and the labouring
and peasant masses should protect against his illegal
arrest. On the other hand, efforts should also be
made to combat the traitors - Zee Shih Keng (徐锡根),
Hu Chuin Ngoh (胡均鹤) (alias Zung Ping Woo), Hu Dah
Hai (胡大海) alias Zung Ching Sai (程金才), and Yuan Ping
Hui (袁炳辉) etc.

Central Committee of the
Chinese Communist Party.
January 16, 1933.

14/1/33 in

pages.zh:
1933年1月22日，市警察在闸北西部查获的一份题为“紧急通告第A.110号”的共产党传单的摘要译文。

黄正（Wong Bing）同志于1932年12月14日被天津区国民党特别队逮捕，随后被押解至南京。目前尚不清楚他是否仍然在世。
他在国民党手中遭受了残酷的酷刑，但通过对无产阶级阶级的忠诚，展现了他伟大的牺牲精神。他是中国劳工运动的领袖，也是世界反帝同盟委员会的成员。
党的各支部以及工农群众应保护他免受非法逮捕。另一方面，也应努力打击叛徒——徐锡根（Zee Shih Keng）、胡均鹤（Hu Chuin Ngoh）（别名程平武 Zung Ping Woo）、胡大海（Hu Dah Hai）（别名程金才 Zung Ching Sai）和袁炳辉（Yuan Ping Hui）等。

中国共产党
中央委员会。
1933年1月16日。

（批注：见附件207中1933年1月14日的报告）

Translation of a communist circular reproduced in a
periodical entitled "Lenin Livelihood", issue No.15,
dated January 15, 1933, which was obtained by the
Municipal Police in Western Chapel on January 22, 1933.

Joint Resolutions on the dismissal of Party Members
Yui Fee (余飛) alias Yui Mau Wai (余茂槐), Joe
Shih Keng (徐錫根), Yuan Ping Hui (袁炳輝) and Sung Ts
Ping (陳資平) have surrendered to the Kuomintang following
their arrest and become traitors for the destruction of
the Party. They are therefore the enemies of the
proletarian classes and have been permanently dismissed
from the Party. In the case of Yuan Ping Hui, he has
also been dismissed from the Chinese Communist Youth
League of which he is concurrently a member. This
resolution is to be published in all Party papers.

Central Committee of the Chinese
Communist Party.
Central Committee of the Chinese
Communist Youth League.
January 1, 1933.

（批：in report dated 1/1/33. attached file.）
pages.zh:
1933年1月22日，市警察在闸北西部（原文误作Chapel，应为Chapei）查获的一份刊登在1933年1月15日出版的第15期《列宁生活》（Lenin Livelihood）期刊上的共产党传单的译文。

关于开除党员余飛（Yui Fee）（别名余茂槐 Yui Mau Wai）、徐錫根（Joe Shih Keng）、袁炳輝（Yuan Ping Hui）和陈資平（Sung Ts Ping）的联合决议
上述人员在被捕后已向国民党投诚，成为破坏党的叛徒。因此，他们是无产阶级阶级的敌人，已被永久开除出党。就袁炳辉而言，他还被同时开除了其身为成员的中国共产主义青年团。本决议将在所有党报上刊登。

中国共产党
中央委员会。
中国共产主义青年团
中央委员会。
1933年1月1日。

（批注：见附件中1933年1月1日的报告。）

January 11, 1933. Morning Translation

COMMUNISM

"Social News", a three-day mosquito paper:

COMMUNIST SLOGANS IN JEN HUA COLLEGE.

A visitor to the Second Branch of the Shanghai
Jen Hua College (文華學院), (address not given), recently
observed the following communist slogans on the walls of
this school:- "Support the Red Army and Soviet", "Down
with X X Party", etc. etc.
There are many communists in the school and
they have acquired much influence. The school authorities
are unable to do anything with them and are leaving the
communists to do what they like.

Surrender of Important Communists.

Following the victory of the bandit suppression
campaign of the government troops, dissensions have broken
out in the Communist Party and a number of communists have
surrendered to the government.
Amongst the important communists who recently
proceeded to Nanking and expressed their repentance are:-
Zee Shih Ken (諸世根), member of the Central
Committee of the Chinese Communist Party, secretary of the
Hupeh, Honan and Anhwei Special District Committee and
general secretary of the All China General Labour
Federation.
Hu Chuin Ngoh (胡春娥), committee member of
the Communist Youth International and general secretary
of the "Central" of the Chinese Communist Youth League.
Yuan Ping Hui (袁平輝), committee member of
"Central" and concurrently chief of the Organization
Department of the Chinese Communist Youth League and
member of the "Central" of the Chinese Communist Party.
Hu Hai Mei (胡海梅), committee member of the
"Central" of the Chinese Communist Youth League and
concurrently chief of the Central Economic Struggle
Department.
A large number of minor communists below the
rank of member of the Central Committee have also gone
over to the government. Thus the end of the Communist
Party may be expected shortly.

LABOUR

Eastern Times and other local newspapers:

STRIKE OF B. A. T. WORKERS ENDED.

In connection with the strike of workers
of the British-American Tobacco Company in Pootung,
a provisional agreement was concluded on January 8 and
the entire body of the strikers resumed work at 3 p.m.
on that day.
It is learned that the agreement was formally
signed at the Social Bureau at 10 a.m. yesterday.

特别调查
O. 1/6 S. B.
1933年1月11日。晨间译文

共产主义

《社会新闻》，一份三日刊的小报：

文華學院内的共产党标语。

一位最近访问上海文華學院第二分院（地址未提供）的人士观察到该校墙壁上有以下共产党标语：“拥护红军和苏维埃”，“打倒XX党”等等。
校内有许多共产党人，他们已获得很大影响力。校方对他们束手无策，任由共产党人为所欲为。

重要共产党人投诚。

随着政府军队剿匪战役的胜利，共产党内部发生分裂，多名共产党人向政府投诚。
近期前往南京并表示悔过的重要共产党人包括：
诸世根（Zee Shih Ken），中国共产党中央委员会委员，鄂豫皖特区委员会书记，中华全国总工会秘书长。
胡春娥（Hu Chuin Ngoh），青年共产国际委员，中国共产主义青年团“中央”秘书长。
袁平輝（Yuan Ping Hui），“中央”委员，兼任中国共产主义青年团组织部部长，中国共产党“中央”委员。
胡海梅（Hu Hai Mei），中国共产主义青年团“中央”委员，兼任中央经济斗争部部长。
大量级别低于中央委员的普通共产党人也已归顺政府。因此，共产党的终结指日可待。

劳工

《申报》及其他本地报纸：

英美烟草公司工人罢工结束。

关于浦东英美烟草公司工人的罢工，双方于1月8日达成临时协议，全体罢工工人于当日下午3时复工。
据悉，该协议已于昨日上午10时在社會局正式签署。
